newsitem.title: USA: Motorola, VocalTec in long distance pact - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Motorola, VocalTec in long distance pact - WSJ.

text.p: Motorola Inc is expected to announce a plan on Friday to license and sell software from VocalTec that would allow corporations to make phone calls via the Internet, the Wall Street Journal said Monday.
The pact "is a strong stamp of approval legitimising the technology," VocalTec Chairman and Chief Executive Elon Ganor told the paper. He declined to reveal financial terms of the deal.
The report said the plan could broaden the presently limited use of Internet telephony, which is cheaper than standard long-distance telephone service.
It said customers would run VocalTec's software on a customised computer that is attached to a switchboard and can run as many as eight lines.
Shares of Northvale, N.J.-based VocalTec closed up 3/8 Friday at 6-1/2.
